about_the_game:
"Oh! Thank goodness you found me here! I need your help! 'Mysterious Magic' has swept through the whole kingdom! I'm stranded and my golden crown has gone missing! The kingdom needs a hero like you! Please rescue me!" — Princess

A challenging grid-based puzzle adventure with cute pixel art graphics and dialog that at least attempts to be funny... It's a puzzle. It's a rescue. It's REZCUE!

Rescue the Princess

Each level in REZCUE requires you to navigate a labyrinth to reach the princess!

  • Smash Blocks - Falling blocks can open up exciting new paths and possibilities.

  • Dodge Danger - Creatures of the kingdom that have been turned against you.

  • Solve Puzzles - Each world introduces new and unique puzzle blocks.

Save the Kingdom

Levels in REZCUE have multiple solutions, but the only way to truly lift the curse of the 'Mysterious Magic' is through perfect scores... obviously!

  • Think Ahead - Each step, fall, and smash counts as a move.

  • Earn Trophies - Clear a level in the fewest moves possible to earn a golden trophy.

  • Lift the Spell - Collect all the trophies to restore peace to the kingdom!

And much much more...

  • Tolerate the Chat - Enjoy jokes, puns, and maybe even learn something after every level.

  • Tackle Challenges - Only the best will unlock the 'Crowning Achievement'

  • Discover Secrets - Locate hidden Love Letters scattered throughout the kingdom.

  • Drink Love Potions - Stuck? Skip with a potion... the princess won't be happy though!

Oh... you're still here... that's awesome! Wishlist REZCUE now and you'll be making the princess (and this solo indie developer) very happy!
